title: Recurring Charge Readback
description: Prevents trial-to-paid and intro-price surprises by reading back, next to the subscribe button, what's charged today, when the first real charge and any price step-up land, and the exact cancel-by time with zone, and by flagging a trial too short to cancel in time or a button whose words ("free", "₹499/mo" on yearly billing) disagree with the charge.
stops: Free trial quietly became a paid plan
